tool.name: Get.group
tool.description: group names from shared or from list and group
tool.command:
@SHELL_OPTIONS@
## create symlinks to input datasets ln -s '$shared' shared.dat &&
## collect the arguments of the mothur command in a list and join them with ## commas, so that the command can never end with a trailing comma #set $mothur_args = [] #silent $mothur_args.append("shared=shared.dat")
echo 'get.group(${",".join($mothur_args)})' | mothur | tee mothur.out.log &&
## parse relevant output from logfile to file ## extract the text mothur prints for this command from its logfile: ## everything between the echoed command and 'Output File Names:' cat mothur.*.logfile | awk '/^mothur > /{f++; next} f==1' | awk '/^Output File Names:/{f=1} !f' | awk 'NF' > "$bootgroups"
tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The get.group_ command generate principle components plot data.
.. _get.group: https://mothur.org/wiki/get.group/
v.1.20.0: Updated to Mothur 1.33
